source: User pasted Windows PowerShell 5.1 ParseException before execution of -Phase Prepare
symptom: The '<' operator is reserved for future use at line 125
The string is missing the terminator at line 202
root_cause: tools/t10_video10_media_device.ps1 was UTF-8 without BOM, containing non-ASCII U+2013 en dash in a quoted status message on line 108. Windows PowerShell 5.1 can decode BOM-less UTF-8 under a legacy system code page and corrupt quotation/parse tokens. Ubuntu pwsh parser did not catch this.
fix: Replace lone U+2013 with ASCII '-' and enforce ASCII-only source plus native Windows PowerShell 5.1 ParseFile regression in .github/workflows/t10-engine-eval.yml asr-adb-windows-regression job.
previous_android_ci_context: Earlier harness commit had full Android CI/T10 eval PASS, but PowerShell 7 Ubuntu parser could not certify Windows PowerShell 5.1 encoding.
